description.name: Uptimeify
description.tagline: Mirror WHMCS clients and domains to Uptimeify uptime, domain-expiry and blacklist monitoring.
description.long: Connect one organization API token and every active hosting domain and registered domain in WHMCS gets monitored in Uptimeify under the matching customer. Provisioning, suspension and termination are mirrored automatically via hooks and cron; clients see their monitors read-only in the client area. Free and open source.
features: Mirrors WHMCS clients 1:1 to Uptimeify customers
Website, domain-expiry, DNS and DNSBL monitors, each switchable
Non-destructive: only monitors the addon created are ever deleted
